mapper.select: SELECT revision_id, doc_id, content, editor_name, editor_ip, revision_comment, created_at FROM wiki_revision WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT revision_id, doc_id, content, editor_name, editor_ip, revision_comment, created_at FROM wiki_revision WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wiki_revision (doc_id, content, editor_name, editor_ip, revision_comment, created_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{content}, #{editorName}, #{editorIp}, #{revisionComment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
